verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0.0 definition for its REST API, but only embedded in the source of its rendered reference page (api.secureframe.com/docs). No separate raw-spec download URL is documented, so a user or agent must pull the spec out of roughly 490KB of page source. A versioning policy with dated API versions is documented. missing for 10: a documented direct download link or endpoint for the raw spec (JSON/YAML), independent or hands-on confirmation that the embedded spec is complete and usable by tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: the document embeds the full "openapi: 3.0.0 / info: title: Secureframe API" OpenAPI definition that the renderer consumes
developer.secureframe.com serves a rendered OpenAPI reference (api.secureframe.com/docs)
